biggest_catch: dscout's own terms say each mission sets its own payment terms — but no bounded payout timing appears anywhere in the official terms.
catches: Official Scout Terms: 'Each Mission will have its own set of terms as to payment, if any' — timing is not bounded in the terms.
dscout 'reserves the right to not compensate Scouts who fail to perform the Mission requirements in a complete and timely manner.'
dscout disclaims control over other Researchers' ability to pay: 'We have no control over... the ability of other Researchers to pay.'
Payment disputes must be raised within 90 days or dscout will not review them.

c1.evidence: Official dscout.com/legal/scout-terms: platform where Researchers post Missions for Scouts to complete via the app.

c2.evidence: Official: 'Each Mission will have its own set of terms as to payment' — amount shown per mission before agreeing.

c3.evidence: Official: 'There is no cost to becoming a Scout.'

c4.evidence: No bounded payout timing in the official Scout Terms — only that payment follows completion. Fails the bounded-timing rule.

notes: Checked 2026-09-23. Rejected: official terms confirm per-mission pay visibility but state no bounded payout timing.
payout_quote: Each Mission will have its own set of terms as to payment, if any, for participation. Scouts are paid only upon completion of the Mission to the specifications provided by the Researcher. (dscout Scout Terms)

s2.note: No cost to become a Scout.
